olivia_sales: Hey team — onboarding ACME for a 4‑week POC. Need to confirm success criteria + integration plan. Quick sync?

mike_se: Yep. Main asks from ACME: live streaming chat, <=500ms 90p latency, and hit ~80 concurrent users. Also want auth + audit logs for compliance.

anjali_pm: Success criteria I proposed: 1) functional chat integration + streaming responses; 2) eval pass rate >=95% on their golden prompt set; 3) token cost under their target $0.002/response. Timeline: week1 infra + auth, week2 prompts/evals, week3 ramp, week4 polish.

olivia_sales: They asked about SDK examples and retry semantics. Can someone paste a minimal example for Node and a recommended retry/backoff?

sam_eng: Node snippet (very small):
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'rw-chat-large', messages });
stream.on('data', (chunk) => console.log(chunk.text));
```
Retry guidance: idempotent requests only. Use exponential backoff with jitter: base=200ms, max=8s, maxAttempts=5. For streaming, fail fast and reconnect with resume token if available.

mike_se: Auth + quotas: we should recommend using per-team API keys + token scoping. For POC we can do project-scoped key with daily quota 200k tokens and 100 rps burst=200. ACME legal asked about RBAC for keys?

devon_sre: We'll enable key-level audit logs in the demo org. For Private/Dedicated customers we support KMS integration. Security bot note: please fill in the security questionnaire items for KMS, SOC2, and data residency — I'll attach answers after this thread.

security_bot: [automated] Demo org provisioned: demo-acme-176874. Audit logs enabled, region: us-west-2, KMS: placeholder.

anjali_pm: For the evals: can we set up an automated run against their golden set on every deploy? Need a pass/fail alert. Target: no regressions >1% from baseline.

sam_eng: Yes — we can wire Redwood Optimize evals into CI. We'll run top-100 prompts nightly and fail build if quality drops. Also add a canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on latency or quality regression.

mike_se: Pricing conversation: recommend using hosted credits for POC then convert to short reserved commit if they want predictable pricing. For POC quote: we estimated ~50k tokens/day -> ~ $100/day at our rates, but we can offer trial credits.

olivia_sales: Streaming edge cases: what about network blips in their web client?

sam_eng: Use chunked streaming + client-side reconnection. Server provides resume_token in stream metadata. If reconnect, client resumes with last_token_id to avoid repeat. If resume_token not supported, replay last N tokens dedup on client.

devon_sre: Rate limits: for POC give them soft limit with headers: `x-rw-limit-remaining`, `x-rw-rate-reset`. If they hit burst, we return 429 with `Retry-After`. Recommend client backoff with exponential jitter.

anjali_pm: Security questionnaire highlights to prep: data retention policy, SSO support, KMS key ownership, SOC2 cert date, incident response SLA. I'll collect answers and attach to the SFDC opportunity.

olivia_sales: Can we confirm exact API endpoints and example cURL for auth+streaming to send to ACME?

sam_eng: cURL example: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{"model":"rw-chat-large","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream
```
Note: use `stream=true` and SSE client. For websockets use `/v1/ws` with subprotocol `rw-stream-v1`.

mike_se: I'll draft the POC statement of work: deliverables, success criteria, quotas, pricing estimate, timeline. Will share by EOD.

olivia_sales: Perfect — also cc'ing legal after Mike shares SOW. Anyone see blockers?

devon_sre: One potential blocker: if ACME requires on-prem data processing we need to evaluate Private deployment lead time (~6–8 weeks). Flagging early.

anjali_pm: Good call. We'll make it explicit in SOW that POC assumes hosted demo in us-west-2 unless they request Private.

olivia_sales: Great. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
